summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates two dark-gray empty-bar images at alpha 0.25 with their literal opposing layout anchors. No weapon statistics are read or modified in this builder. Exact child order: LeftEmptyBar, RightEmptyBar. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace.
